~~~{=latex}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
\small\setstretch{1}\DontPrintSemicolon
\caption{Pathwise exact coordinate descent with concomitant scale}
\label{alg:concomitant}
\KwInput{$X\in\mathbb R^{n\times p},y\in\mathbb R^n,\lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_L>0$;
\addition{$\rho,a,\sigma^{(0)},\epsilon,\epsilon_\sigma,\gamma>0,\ B,K,T\in\mathbb N_+,\ \mathcal U\in\{\mathrm{MM},\mathrm{Root},\mathrm{Prox}\}$}}
$\widehat\beta_0\leftarrow0$; \addition{$\widehat\sigma_0\leftarrow\sigma^{(0)}$}\;
\For{$\ell=1,\ldots,L$}{
 $\beta\leftarrow\widehat\beta_{\ell-1}$, $r\leftarrow y-X\beta$;
 \addition{$\sigma\leftarrow\widehat\sigma_{\ell-1}$}\;
 \For{$k=1,\ldots,K$}{
  \addition{$M\leftarrow\|r\|_\infty$}\;
  \addition{\If{$M=0$}{\KwReturn{$((\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m<\ell},(\beta,0,0))$}}}
  \addition{$q\leftarrow r/M$; $t\leftarrow\sigma/M$; $m\leftarrow\#\{i:q_i\ne0\}$}\;
  \addition{\If{$2na\ge m\rho^2$}{\KwReturn{$((\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m<\ell},(\beta,0,0))$}}}
  \addition{$(t,b,\nu)\leftarrow\mathrm{Scale}_{\mathcal U}(q,t;B,T,\epsilon_\sigma,\gamma)$; $\sigma\leftarrow Mt$}\;
  \addition{$\delta\leftarrow\rho\sigma$;\quad $\eta\leftarrow\sigma\lambda_\ell$}\;
  \addition{$E\leftarrow\{j:\beta_j\ne0\}
    \cup\{j:|X_j^\top\psi_\delta(r)/n|>\eta\}$}\;
  \For{$j\in E,\quad j\uparrow$}{
    $u\leftarrow r+X_j\beta_j$;\quad $\beta_j^-\leftarrow\beta_j$\;
    $\beta_j\leftarrow\mathrm{ExactHuberCoordinate}(u,X_j,\delta,\eta)$\;
    $r\leftarrow r-X_j(\beta_j-\beta_j^-)$\;
  }
  \addition{$v_\beta\leftarrow R_\beta(\beta,r,\sigma,\lambda_\ell)$;\quad
              $v_\sigma\leftarrow R_\sigma(r,\sigma)$}\;
  \addition{\If{$\max(v_\beta,v_\sigma)\le\epsilon$}{\textbf{break}}}
 }
 $\widehat\beta_\ell\leftarrow\beta$;
 \addition{$\widehat\sigma_\ell\leftarrow\sigma$;\quad
   $\kappa_\ell\leftarrow\mathbf1_{\{\max(v_\beta,v_\sigma)\le\epsilon\}}$}\;
 \addition{\If{$\kappa_\ell=0$}{\KwReturn{$(\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m=1}^{\ell}$}}}
}
\KwReturn{$(\widehat\beta_\ell,\addition{\widehat\sigma_\ell,\kappa_\ell})_{\ell=1}^{L}$}
\end{algorithm}

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\small\setstretch{1}\DontPrintSemicolon
\caption{$\mathrm{ExactHuberCoordinate}(u,x,\delta,\eta)$}
\label{alg:coordinate}
\KwInput{$u,x\in\mathbb R^n,\ \delta>0,\ \eta\ge0$}
\KwOutput{$\displaystyle\theta\in\arg\min_{b\in\mathbb R}
          \{n^{-1}\sum_i h_\delta(u_i-x_ib)+\eta|b|\}$}
$g_0\leftarrow-n^{-1}\sum_i x_i\operatorname{sign}(u_i)\min\{|u_i|,\delta\}$\;
\If{$|g_0|\le\eta$}{\KwReturn{$0$}}
$d\leftarrow-\operatorname{sign}(g_0)$;\quad $D\leftarrow dg_0+\eta$;\quad $c\leftarrow0$\;
$I\leftarrow\{i:x_i\ne0\}$\;
\For{$i\in I$}{
 $w_i\leftarrow x_i^2/n$;\quad
 $a_i\leftarrow u_i/(dx_i)-\delta/|x_i|$;\quad
 $b_i\leftarrow u_i/(dx_i)+\delta/|x_i|$\;
}
$S\leftarrow\sum_{i\in I}w_i\mathbf1_{\{a_i\le0<b_i\}}$\;
$\{v_1<\cdots<v_M\}\leftarrow
  (\{a_i:i\in I\}\cup\{b_i:i\in I\})\cap(0,\infty)$\;
\For{$m=1,\ldots,M$}{
 $J_m\leftarrow\sum_{i\in I}w_i(\mathbf1_{\{a_i=v_m\}}-\mathbf1_{\{b_i=v_m\}})$\;
 \If{$S>0\ \mathrm{and}\ D+S(v_m-c)\ge0$}{\KwReturn{$d(c-D/S)$}}
 $D\leftarrow D+S(v_m-c)$;\quad $c\leftarrow v_m$;\quad $S\leftarrow S+J_m$\;
}
\KwReturn{$dc$}
\end{algorithm}

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\small\setstretch{1}\DontPrintSemicolon
\caption{\addition{$\mathrm{SafeguardedSupportStep}(\beta,\sigma)$ (optional)}}
\label{alg:polish}
\addition{
$J\leftarrow\{j:\beta_j\ne0\}\cup\{j:j\ \mathrm{unpenalized}\}$\;
\If{$|J|=0\ \mathrm{or}\ |J|>128$}{\KwReturn{$(\beta,\sigma)$}}
$z\leftarrow(\beta_J,\sigma)$;\quad
$g\leftarrow\nabla_J F_{\lambda_0}(\beta,\sigma)$;\quad
$H\leftarrow\nabla_J^2 F_{\lambda_0}(\beta,\sigma)$\;
$\mu\leftarrow10^{-10}\max_j H_{jj}$\;
\If{$\mu=0$}{\KwReturn{$(\beta,\sigma)$}}
$d\leftarrow-(H+\mu I)^{-1}g$\;
\If{$g^\top d\ge0$}{\KwReturn{$(\beta,\sigma)$}}
\For{$m=0,\ldots,23$}{
 $t\leftarrow2^{-m}$;\quad $(\beta_J^+,\sigma^+)\leftarrow z+td$;\quad
 $\beta_{J^c}^+\leftarrow0$\;
 \If{$\sigma^+>0\ \mathrm{and}\ F_{\lambda_0}(\beta^+,\sigma^+)
     \le F_{\lambda_0}(\beta,\sigma)+10^{-4}t g^\top d$}{
  \KwReturn{$(\beta^+,\sigma^+)$}
 }
}
\KwReturn{$(\beta,\sigma)$}
}
\end{algorithm}
